subject: SDK Turbine onboarding: telemetry, quota & failsafe playbook
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Moreno <alex.moreno@cumuluspay.com>, integrations@cumuluspay.com
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: SDK Turbine onboarding: telemetry, quota & failsafe playbook

Alex / CumulusPay team —

Thanks again for committing to the pilot. This thread is to align the handoff and implementation plan so your engineers have a clear path for SDK setup, endpoint migration, retries/timeouts, and rate-limit handling. I attached a short timeline and the starter snippets (sdk-turbine-snippets.tar.gz) you can drop into your repo.

High-level plan (week 0 -> week 3):
- Week 0: credentials + sandbox access (we'll provision a dedicated sandbox for your account)
- Week 1: SDK integration + basic telemetry (client init, request/response metrics)
- Week 2: Endpoint migration testing (staging -> canary), KV caching & prefix fallback tests
- Week 3: Load test, quota tuning, go/no-go cutover play

Key operational asks for your infra team:
- Reserve a stable DNS name for the canary gateway we can target (helps keep rollout simple)
- Share any proxy/mTLS requirements so our SDK can be configured accordingly
- Provide expected QPS per route so we can tune batching and burst windows

Quick notes about the SDK snippets:
- The sample demonstrates: initialization, per-request telemetry hooks, adaptive batching, a recommended retry policy (exponential backoff with jitter), and a simple on-client quota fence that emits a soft 429 before hitting platform limits.
- We recommend 3 retry attempts for idempotent requests (POST generation calls kept idempotent by a client token), 2 attempts for non-idempotent with an error budget check.

Open items for the kickoff call I've scheduled with your calendar invite:
- Confirm sandbox host and credentials
- Confirm token rotation cadence for the sandbox and prod
- Walk through the security questionnaire items that your compliance team flagged (attached)

Attachments: MVP_Onboarding_Timeline.xlsx, sdk-turbine-snippets.tar.gz, security-questionnaire.pdf

Thanks — happy to sync live if any of the items below need clarification.

— Irene
Irene Choi
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
irene@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0129

From: Alex Moreno <alex.moreno@cumuluspay.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 11:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SDK Turbine onboarding: telemetry, quota & failsafe playbook

Irene —

Appreciate the overview and attachments. A couple quick clarifying questions from our side before the technical kickoff: 

1) Can you confirm the recommended socket timeout and overall request timeout for generation calls in the snippets? Our gateway currently enforces a 10s socket idle timeout.
2) On the retry policy: do you include idempotency keys inside the snippets or do you expect the integrator to supply them?
3) Regarding the "soft 429" behavior — if our payment workflow sees a soft 429, what's the recommended client behavior? Queue and retry, or surface to users?

We'll be on the kickoff call later today. I'll bring our lead backend engineer (Jill Park) and a compliance representative.

Thanks,
Alex
Director of Payments Engineering
Alex Moreno | alex.moreno@cumuluspay.com | +1 646-555-3301

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Moreno <alex.moreno@cumuluspay.com>, Jill Park <jill.park@cumuluspay.com>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 15:01:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SDK Turbine onboarding: telemetry, quota & failsafe playbook

Alex / Jill —

Following up from today’s tech call (great session). A couple tactical items we agreed to capture here so your engineers have them in writing: 

- Canary host: canary.cumulus.svc (we can update if you prefer a different FQDN)
- Token rotation: rotate sandbox tokens every 14 days, prod every 90 days; we provide automated rotation hooks in the SDK.
- Rate limits: initial quota per account set to 250 QPS aggregate, per-route soft window at 75% of per-route quota — SDK emits a RATE_NEAR event to telemetry and applies soft-429 queueing.
- Batching: default batch window 20ms or max batch size 8 for small-generation routes; you can increase batch window for higher throughput but expect latency tradeoffs.

We also posted a short checklist to the shared drive: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1A2B3OnboardingNotes (contains a cutover checklist, rollback steps and load test templates).

Action owners:
- Cumulus (Jill): validate canary DNS and share proxy headers by EOD Friday
- Redwood (Vivek): publish a small load test harness and a runnable docker image with the SDK snippets by Monday

If anything is missing from these notes, flag it and we’ll update the checklist. Looking forward to the staging cutover next week.

— Vivek Kulkarni
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
vivek@redwood.ai | +1 510-555-0199
